privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains how {appName} handles your account, the photos you upload, the videos we generate and the credits you use.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.content:
{appName} is an online service that turns your photos into short videos using ready-made templates. We operate the website and the account, storage and generation service behind it.

This policy covers the website and the generation service.

informationCollect.title: Information we collect
informationCollect.content:
Account information: your email address, name and sign-in method, and, if you sign in with a third-party provider, the basic profile it shares.

Content: the photos you upload and the videos generated from them.

Usage and device information: pages visited, approximate location from your IP address, browser type and a device identifier used to prevent abuse of free credits.

Payment information: purchases are handled by our payment provider. We receive the purchase record, not your full card details.

howWeUse.title: How we use information
howWeUse.content: We use your information to provide the service: to sign you in, generate the videos you request, store them in your account, process payments and credits, provide support, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve the service.

photosAndVideos.title: Photos and generated videos
photosAndVideos.content:
When you generate a video, your photos and the template's reference clip are sent to our video generation provider to render the result. The provider processes these files only to complete your request.

People in the photos can be recognized in the result. Upload a photo only when you have the right to use it and the person has agreed to appear. Do not upload photos of children.

Generated videos are AI recreations and may be imperfect. They are not statements by the people in the photos.

informationSharing.title: Sharing
informationSharing.content: We share information only with service providers that help us run the service (hosting, storage, email, payments, analytics and video generation), when the law requires it, or to protect the rights and safety of users and the service. We do not sell your personal information.

dataRetention.title: Retention and deletion
dataRetention.content:
Uploaded photos are deleted automatically 30 days after the video is created. Generated videos stay in your account while it is open.

Email {supportEmail} to ask us to delete your account and the content stored for it sooner. We may keep limited records when the law, a dispute, fraud prevention or a payment requires it.

security.title: Security
security.content: We use encryption in transit, access controls and private storage to protect your information. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password or a trusted sign-in provider.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.content: We use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences such as language and theme. If analytics is enabled, we use it to understand how the site is used in aggregate.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.content: You can ask us to access, correct, export or delete the information we hold about you. Email {supportEmail} from the address on your account. Depending on where you live, local law may give you additional rights, including the right to complain to a data protection authority.

children.title: Children
children.content: The service is not directed to children under 16. Do not create an account or upload a photo if you are under 16, and do not upload photos of anyone under 16. If you believe we hold a child's data, contact us and we will delete it.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms are the agreement between you and the operator of {appName}. Signing in or generating a video means you agree to them.

theService.title: The service
theService.content: {appName} lets you pick a video template, upload photos and receive a short generated video. Generating a video uses credits; the cost is shown before you start.

accountResponsibilities.title: Your account
accountResponsibilities.content: Keep your sign-in details secure and tell us about any unauthorized use. You are responsible for activity under your account. One person per account.

photosAndConsent.title: Photos and consent
photosAndConsent.content: Only upload photos you have the right to use, of people who have agreed to appear in a generated video. Do not upload photos of children, of public figures, or that you do not have rights to.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.content: Do not use the service to create content that is illegal, harassing, sexual, deceptive or that impersonates someone, and do not try to break, overload or reverse-engineer the service. We may refuse or remove content that breaks these rules.

intellectualProperty.title: Content and rights
intellectualProperty.content: You keep the rights you have in your photos and give us a limited permission to process them to provide the service. You may download, keep and share the videos generated for your account, provided you respect the rights of the people in them and the rules of the platforms where you post. The service, its templates and site content remain ours.

billingAndRefunds.title: Credits, payments and refunds
billingAndRefunds.content: Credits are bought in one-time packs and are used when you generate. If a generation fails, its credits are returned automatically. Purchases are otherwise final except where the law requires a refund.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.content: Generated videos are produced by AI and may contain errors or artifacts. The service is provided as is, without warranties of any kind to the extent the law allows.

liabilityLimit.title: Limitation of liability
liabilityLimit.content: To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: You can stop using the service at any time. Email {supportEmail} to close your account. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms.

changesToTerms.title: Changes
changesToTerms.content: We may update these terms. If a change is material, we will notify you before it takes effect. Continuing to use the service means you accept the updated terms.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.description: When you get your credits or money back on {appName}, and how refunds reach you.

failedRenders.title: Videos that fail
failedRenders.content: A video uses the number of credits shown before you press Generate. If a photo isn't approved by the video provider's review, or the render fails for any reason, those credits go back to your balance automatically, usually within minutes. You don't need to ask, and you can use them for another video right away.

creditPacks.title: Credit packs
creditPacks.content:
Credit packs are one-time purchases, not subscriptions, and purchased credits don't expire. Credits are added to your account as soon as the payment succeeds, so delivered credits aren't refunded in cash, except where the law requires it, the payment failed, or we didn't deliver the credits you paid for.

If a payment went through but the credits are missing, contact us and we'll add them or refund the payment.

freeCredits.title: Free and promotional credits
freeCredits.content: Credits we grant for free, for example on sign-up or in a promotion, have no cash value, can't be refunded and may expire as shown in your credit history.

ourSide.title: When something goes wrong on our side
ourSide.content: If an outage or a bug on our side stops videos from being made, the credits are returned as described above. If you were affected in a way these rules don't cover, write to us and we'll put it right.

howRefundsAppear.title: How cash refunds appear
howRefundsAppear.content: Cash refunds go back to your original payment method through our payment provider. A refund issued shortly after the payment often cancels the pending charge, so the charge may simply disappear from your statement. Otherwise banks usually show the refund within 5 to 10 business days.

contactUs.title: Questions and requests
contactUs.content:
If you think you were charged by mistake or a refund hasn't arrived, email {supportEmail} from the address on your account, with the date and amount of the payment.

Mandatory consumer rights in your place of residence remain in force.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: The cookies and on-device storage {appName} uses, and how you can control them.

overview.title: What this page covers
overview.content: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. Besides cookies, we keep some information in your browser's local storage and IndexedDB. This page lists what we store and why. Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal data overall.

essential.title: Needed for the site to work
essential.content:
A sign-in cookie keeps you signed in. A language cookie and a theme setting remember your choices. A random device identifier, kept in a cookie and in local storage, helps us stop abuse of sign-ups and free credits.

These can't be switched off on the site. Blocking them in your browser signs you out or resets your preferences.

onDevice.title: Stored only on your device
onDevice.content:
When you sign in or go to checkout, the photos you picked are kept in your browser (IndexedDB) so they're still there when you come back, and they're cleared once they're used. We also remember a checkout in progress so we can confirm it when you return, and small preferences such as whether you turned the soundtrack off.

This information stays in your browser and isn't used for advertising.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.content:
If analytics is enabled, we use it to count visits and see which pages and steps work; the analytics provider may set its own cookies, such as Google Analytics' _ga. We also keep, in local storage, the page that first brought you here and the last template you used, so purchases can be credited to the right page.

Analytics never receives your photos or videos.

payments.title: Payments
payments.content: Checkout happens on our payment provider's pages. The provider sets its own cookies there to process the payment and prevent fraud; see its privacy policy for details.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.content: You can block or delete cookies and site data in your browser settings at any time. Blocking analytics cookies doesn't change how the site works. Blocking the sign-in cookie signs you out.

trend.title: What is the AI celebrity autograph trend?
body: In the autograph trend, an ordinary photo becomes a celebrity fan meet: you walk up to a signing table under a giant poster of your own face, fans hold up their phones, and you sign a photo for one of them. It works because it looks like real fan-cam footage of someone famous, and the someone is you.
This template gives you that moment from one photo. You get a {seconds}-second {aspect} clip filmed from the fans' side of the table: the walk-in, the smile, the autograph and the hand-back.

faq.q: Does a real celebrity appear in the video?
faq.a: No. You are the star, and the poster behind you shows your own face. The fans and the bodyguard are generic extras, and no real celebrity or brand appears in the clip.

faq.q: Is the autograph a real signature?
faq.a: No. The signing is a quick scribble, not readable handwriting, so nobody's real signature is copied.

whatItIs.content: {appName} turns everyday photos into short, share-ready trend videos. Pick a template, add the photos it asks for, and download an MP4 without a watermark.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.content:
Each template starts from a reference clip that carries the moves, the staging and the camera. An AI video model recasts that clip with the people in your photos, and the template's soundtrack is added to the finished video.

Your photos first go through the model provider's review. If a photo isn't approved or the render fails, your credits come back automatically.

pricing.title: Straightforward pricing
pricing.content: No subscription. Credit packs are one-time purchases and purchased credits don't expire. You see the exact price of a video before you start.

privacy.title: Your photos stay yours
privacy.content: Uploaded photos and finished videos are private to your account. We never publish them, show them to other users or use them in examples or marketing.

orders.content: Write from the email on your account and include the date of the purchase or render. If you have the link to your video, include it too: it lets us find it quickly.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.content: Videos that fail return their credits automatically. Our Refund Policy explains how it works and how long cash refunds take to appear.
